transcript: Khed Shivapur toll ke paas NH48 pe raat 9 baje ek truck ne peeche se thok diya. Peeche ka bumper, right side ki tail light aur quarter panel damage ho gaye.
translation_en: A truck hit my car from behind on NH48 near the Khed Shivapur toll at around 9 PM. The rear bumper, right tail lamp and right rear quarter are damaged.
location_text: NH48 near Khed Shivapur toll plaza
